convoLines.text: "Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them."
Miguel has an edge today — something curdled.
The ground remembers.
Names, named.
You watch who eats with whom, who laughs a little too loud at whose jokes. Nothing solid. Keep looking.
The moot is called. The fire gets built up.
You say nothing. The silence sits at the fire with everyone else.
"...I need to go be quiet for a while."
The silence stretches a beat too long. They study their hands.
"...Sorry, lost my train of thought."
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember."
"There's more, but that's for another fire."
The moot is called. The fire gets built up.
Counted.
"Heh. Nobody's asked me that in a while. ...I'm alright. Getting there."
"That's... pretty much all of it, honestly."
"Sorry — I got lost in it for a second. What did you want to ask?"
"Have you heard what they're calling White Noise? June is pushing 'Big Loud'. Everyone's got a name for it and nobody agrees."
"I see." They take a moment to think about your answer.
"Not right now. I've got my own things to handle."
"Right. Action time. You know where to find me."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"This was good." They mean it.
"What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday."
"The free things. Turns out they were the expensive ones."
"...Sorry — I was a blacksmith — fun was whatever I could steal between shifts. Now fun is watching the fire and not being afraid. It's a downgrade and an upgrade."
"Still on what you did for fun."
"...Sorry, lost my train of thought."
"Forget I said anything. What did you want? ...sorry, lost it."
"Ines always took the burnt piece. Said someone had to. I take it now."
"Alright — I should get back to it."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Hm. Never mind — go on."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
«Gut, dass du da bist. Wirklich.» "Thank you?" — they grin, proud of the one English they know.
«Ja, ja, genau.» (you catch 'Ja' — yes) They nod back, slowly.
«Schön, dass es dich gibt.» (you catch 'Schön' — nice) A grin breaks through, quick and warm.
«Das werde ich dir nie vergessen.» (you catch 'nie' — never, 'vergessen' — forget) You tap your chest, then theirs. Us. They nod, emphatic.
You listen hard, watching their mouth shape the words. «Hast du etwas zu essen? Irgendwas?» (you catch 'essen' — to eat)
Sanne laughs — with you, mostly. "Good try! Again — Richtig, du hast recht.." They walk you through it, patient as sunrise.
A warmth settles over the conversation — they lean in a little.
"Right. Go on, then."
"...Sorry, lost my train of thought."

deathBeat: d7: 🕯️ Angela Stein is dead — a hushwolf. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
recoverHome: d8: That night, they bring Angela home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
systemVoice: d7: SYSTEM: Quest protocol integrated. Objectives will appear.
d7: SYSTEM: Identification complete. You are 0.3% less lost.

d8: ◈ THE SPARK — something clicks. A trick Ines learned long ago suddenly has edges it never had. SYSTEM: "ANOMALY: organic unit demonstrates pattern recognition. Slot capacity increased. We are taking notes." (Ability slots: 3)
d8: ◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 3,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.

d8: ◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."
burialWindowSay: d7: 📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"
d8: That night, they bring Angela home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
d11: You say a few words for them. Not a ceremony — just: you were here, and someone noticed you leaving. (-3 trauma)
d11: You bury them. A marker, of sorts. The village will know where. (+2 trauma)
